extDesc.message: Search and highlight web pages with regular expressions. Line-based ^ $, Unicode mode always on, Onigmo-style \p{han} names.

actionTitle.message: Search this page with a regex

followTitle.message: Keep searching with the same pattern when this tab goes to another page. Asks for access to all sites the first time. Press Clear to stop.

favEmpty.message: Save the current pattern with the ☆ button

truncated.message: Too many matches; showing only the first $a$

emptyMatches.message: $a$ zero-length matches cannot be highlighted and were skipped

favFull.message: Favorites are full (up to $a$, within Chrome sync's 8 KB storage limit). Remove some you no longer use

permFailed.message:
The permission request failed: $a$
Reload this extension (↻) at chrome://extensions and try again.

permDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so "Keep searching after navigation" is off

errUnknownProp.message:
Unknown Unicode property: $a$
Write scripts as \p{Han} or \p{Hangul} and categories as \p{L} or \p{Lu} (case-insensitive).

noteProps.message: Property names were converted to JS syntax: $a$

noteUFallback.message: The pattern is invalid with the v flag, so it was searched with the u flag: $a$

errCompile.message: Could not compile the regular expression

errNoHighlight.message: This browser does not support the CSS Custom Highlight API
